result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but there is one clearly broken content element (a '-100%' discount badge) plus a couple of minor styling/consistency and contrast issues. Horizontal clipping of the carousel/chips and the bottom-cut card were excluded per instructions.

issues.description: The promotional badge on the pizza card reads '−100%', which implies the item is entirely free. This is almost certainly a data/formatting error (e.g., a doubled sign or a percentage computed incorrectly) and undermines trust in the pricing information.
issues.suggestion: Validate discount values before rendering (clamp to a plausible range, e.g. 5–50%) and fix the sign/formatting logic so the badge shows a realistic value such as '−20%'.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons are inconsistent: on the ramen card the heart sits directly on the image with no backing shape, while on the pizza card it has a dark circular background. This makes the affordance look unfinished on the first card.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same semi-transparent dark circular background (or scrim) behind the heart icon on all restaurant cards for consistent visibility and tap affordance.

issues.description: The search field placeholder 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is light gray on a very light gray fill, giving low contrast that may be hard to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text (aim for at least 4.5:1 contrast against the field background) or use a darker field fill.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' row, the delivery-time pill overlaps the food image and sits flush against the card's bottom-left corner, partially covering the dish and looking cramped compared to the badge placement on the larger cards.
issues.suggestion: Inset the time pill consistently (e.g., 8–12px from the image edges) or place it below the image so it does not obscure the food photo.
